description: This course covers project initiation, planning, execution, monitoring, and closure using PMBOK 7th edition standards; Agile methodologies including Scrum and Kanban; project scheduling with Microsoft Project and Gantt charts; risk management techniques using the Risk Matrix and Monte Carlo simulations; resource allocation and budgeting with earned value management; quality assurance with ISO 9001; change control processes; and project closure metrics. Students will engage with real-world case studies involving IT infrastructure upgrades, cloud migration, and cybersecurity projects.

clos.text: Define the core components of a project charter, including objectives, stakeholders, and deliverables using PMBOK 7th edition guidelines.
Describe the differences between Scrum and Kanban frameworks, including their sprint planning, daily standups, and retrospectives.
Explain how to create a Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) and schedule tasks using Microsoft Project with dependencies and milestones.
Apply risk assessment techniques such as the Risk Matrix and Monte Carlo simulations to evaluate project uncertainties.
Implement a project closure plan that includes stakeholder feedback, lessons learned, and final deliverable verification using ISO 9001 standards.

labs: Create a Gantt chart for a software development project using Microsoft Project
Conduct a risk assessment using a Risk Matrix for a cloud migration project
Implement a quality assurance plan for an IT infrastructure upgrade
Perform earned value analysis on a hypothetical project dataset
Prepare a project closure report following ISO 9001 standards
Present a final project presentation with evaluation metrics and stakeholder feedback
